```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(GENESPACE)
```

# Syntenic Plots

Here, we can run orthofinder and genespace to check the synteny of each isolate.

The orthofinder we used is:

```{bash eval=FALSE}
orthofinder -f "$HOME/project_data/downy/genespace/tmp" -t 10 -a 10 -X -o "$HOME/project_data/downy/genespace/orthofinder"
```

Reference genomes: Peronospora effusa, Bremia lactucae, Phytophthora sojae

Our isolates: Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1, Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982, Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli

```{r  message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results=FALSE}
genomeRepo <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/genomes/"
wd <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/"
path2mcscanx <- "/Users/yixuanyang/miniforge3/bin/"
folders <- list.dirs(genomeRepo, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
# all folder except c("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli")
genomes2run <- folders[!folders %in% c("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli", "Phytophthora_agathidicida")]
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = genomes2run,
  genomeIDs = genomes2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  genespaceWd = wd)
asm2run <- c("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = c(asm2run, "Phytophthora_agathidicida"),
  genomeIDs = c(asm2run, "Phytophthora_agathidicida"),
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd)

gpar <- init_genespace(
  wd = wd,
  nCores = 10,
  dotplots = 'never',
  path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)

out <- run_genespace(gpar)
```

# Riparian

```{r echo=FALSE}
for (asm in asm2run){
  plot_riparian(
    gsParam = out,
    genomeIDs = c(asm, genomes2run[1]),
    refGenome = genomes2run[1],
    chrLabFontSize = 2,
    useRegions = FALSE)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c(genomes2run[1],asm2run),
  refGenome = genomes2run[1],
  chrLabFontSize = 2,
  useRegions = FALSE)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c(genomes2run[3:1],asm2run[3:1]),
  refGenome = genomes2run[1],
  #chrLabFontSize = 2,
  chrLabFun = function(x) "",
  useRegions = FALSE)
```


# Phylogenetic Tree


```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

tree.path <- file.path(wd, 'results/SpeciesTree_rooted.txt')
tree <- ggtree(read.tree(tree.path))
tree_data <- tree$data
tip_data <- tree_data[tree_data$isTip, ]
species_order <- tip_data$label[order(tip_data$y)]
num_species <- length(species_order)

# make sure both figure using same limits
y_limits <- c(0.5, num_species + 0.5)
aligned_tree <- tree +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 10, l = 10))

aligned_synteny <- full.plot$plotData$ggplotObj +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = y_limits, 
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = 1:num_species,
    labels = species_order) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black") 
  )

aligned_tree + aligned_synteny + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 4))
```
